Appraiser remarks
The front bumper cover is cracked across the center and the upper radiator support has been pushed rearward, with
the hood latch assembly bent and both headlamp brackets broken. Most of this damage lines up with the frontal
impact as described. Structural measurements taken at the shop match the repair plan, which calls for replacing the
bumper cover, radiator support, hood latch, and both headlamp assemblies, followed by a wheel alignment and a
check of the cooling system. The labor hours allotted for each step fit the extent of the damage. The invoices
submitted show no repeated charges for the same work. No earlier damage to this vehicle is known from the records
reviewed.
